newsitem.title: USA: Arco says to restart Calif. coker Sept. 21.
newsitem.headline: Arco says to restart Calif. coker Sept. 21.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) said on Tuesday it plans to restart the number two coker at its Carson, Calif., refinery on September 21 following a shutdown earlier this month.
"It'll be up to full capacity by (September) 21," a refinery spokesman told Reuters.
The coker, which closed in early September due to unspecified problems, forced the refinery to cut crude runs.
The refinery ran crude oil at a rate of 245,000 bpd on Tuesday, down from its normal capacity of about 260,000 bpd.
Last week, the refinery cut runs to 190,000 bpd, the spokesman said.
"We're about 20,000 bpd off our average runs," the spokesman said.
